messages.message: Hey Austria! Interested in an AI? I think it can be one of the strongest alliances on the board, so I'd be down for that.
Hey Russia, interested in working together? I think our alliance is super underrated, so people don't see it coming. Anyways, I'm up for a lot of things. Anything in particular you'd like to try?

Hey Germany! Just reaching out to say I think our two nations tend to benefit a ton from working together and sharing info, especially into lategame, so I'm down for a long-term alliance. Let me know your thoughts on England/belgium!
Hey Turkey! Wanted to get a feel for what you were thinking for this game. Interested in working together?
I'd definitely be down for that! I think it's the most powerful and the least expected.
Hey Russia! Wanna bounce in Galicia?
Hey Turkey! What are your thoughts on our border and Russia?
Hey Germany! I think we can be a great pair together in the mid game, and be good early allies. Would you be interested in trying to cooperate early?
Hey France! What are your thoughts on this game? I'd love to work with you if you're open to it.
Hey Austria! I'm absolutely down for a bounce. Are you open to some kind of AIR?
A-R can be awesome too if you want to try it.
Hey England! Any plans to head toward the north?
Hey Italy, absolutely! I really like the IT if we can manage to get it off the ground

Hey England! Just reaching out to say I think our two nations tend to benefit a ton from working together, so I'm down for a long-term alliance. I'm thinking we DMZ the Channel and then you hit Russia while I hit Italy and we try to keep Germany in check. Sound good?
Hey Italy! I love the R-I alliance. Let's see if Austria is willing to join?
Hey Germany! How's it going?
Yeah I'd be open to that! Italy has already offered and that definitely seems preferable to a juggernaut.
Hey France! How's it going?
Not yet, but I could be convinced. How about yourself?
Hey Russia! I'm hoping we can juggernaut this one, if not we can at least go for a standard RT alliance. Would you like to bounce the Black?
Hey Germany! Us central powers gotta stick together. Do you think you'll focus north or west?
Hey England! Hope we can stay out of each other's hair?
Russia is interested in AIR
Great! We can split up the Balkans then
Hey France! How do things look over in the west?
Hey Turkey! How's it going?
I certainly hope so as well! Good luck in the game and feel free to reach out any time!

Hey Russia, how's it going? I'm doing well!
I hope we can work together this game. What are your thoughts on Scandinavia?

Hey Austria! How's it going. I've only heard back from England so far, but I'll let you know if I hear anything interesting. We definitely have a lot to gain from sharing intel and working together in the mid-game, so I'm down for a long-term alliance.
